name: Sunshine State Conference Cross Country Championships
headline: Sunshine State Conference Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Tampa swept the titles, edging Embry-Riddle 41-42 for the men’s crown and winning the women’s with 33 to Embry-Riddle’s 52. Embry-Riddle swept the individual races through Taye Newman (24:05.3) and Emily Tubbs (21:30.5).
